mutations.name: a phone gets the table instead of cards
kills: the tasks list on a phone stacks each task into a card with its id, title, initiative and stage instead of the table

mutations.name: a card's task link keeps only its text's height
kills: the tasks list on a phone gives each card's task link a 44px tap target

mutations.name: a card drops the initiative and severity line
kills: the tasks list on a phone stacks each task into a card with its id, title, initiative and stage instead of the table

mutations.name: a desktop gets cards instead of the table
kills: the tasks list on a phone keeps the table on a desktop
